description: This file defines the EmployeePictureDao class, which provides data access methods for employee picture entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to save an employee picture and retrieve an employee picture by employee number.

classes.name: EmployeePictureDao
classes.description: Data access object for employee picture entities, extending the BaseDao to leverage core database functionalities. It provides methods to save and retrieve employee pictures.

methods.name: saveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Persists an EmpPicture entity to the database and returns the persisted entity.

methods.name: getEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches an EmpPicture based on employee number; returns null if no picture exists.
